title: sieve_admin user_exists case mismatch with SMTP RCPT
description: sieve_admin.rs user_exists() uses == (case-sensitive) but SMTP RCPT matching uses eq_ignore_ascii_case. If username configured as Alice, admin returns 404 for alice even though SMTP delivers to alice. Fix: use eq_ignore_ascii_case in user_exists or enforce lowercase usernames at config load.
